scope: Existing own synthetic records and fixed public source only. No new PG/process/auth/model/installation/personal access. Original result is unchanged.
confirmed: The same nonce/PID wrapper reached child-exit with SIGTERM and zero captured stderr. The fixed runService chain passed its load/marker/policy/serviceRuntime path and spawned the actual server command before observed exit. The controller still did not establish an owned listener at its last predicate; health remained unobserved.
missing: Producer stages overwrite one record. No durable child-spawn start time or server-main entered/listen stage exists. Child-spawn success does not prove module-load completion, and final SIGTERM is the controller cleanup, not the original startup cause. Missing startup-failure.json alone is not proof of no error.

nextSmallOption.purpose: Before controller cleanup, preserve one bounded snapshot of the existing same-nonce producer record alongside the failed predicate.
nextSmallOption.ownership: Not taken; all current product paths released. Lead must coordinate any future write.
nextSmallOption.reuse: Existing waitReady failure persistence and private startup record, one observation only, no second supervisor. Fixed driver can consume new controller/reader while selected2515 runtime remains unchanged.
nextSmallOption.port: Small optional trusted startup observation port with default original behavior. Reader checks directory and regular0600/nlink1/self identity, role/PID/nonce, <=4096B, fixed phase/code/exit/stderr-metadata fields; never returns stderr text, environment or config.
nextSmallOption.failure: Missing/unreadable/changed/foreign record is unknown and cannot replace the readiness primary or skip cleanup.
nextSmallOption.proofLimit: Shows producer last phase at the actual pre-stop observation time. Does not reconstruct phase durations or distinguish progress inside server import/listen. Real producer timing would require changing selected runtime and an independently reviewed new artifact, which is outside this proposal.
nextSmallOption.requiredDirectConsumers: Injected same-nonce/foreign-nonce/missing/changed private record and primary+cleanup preservation; shadow loader resolves the exact new reader. No actual host now authorized.
